newsitem.title: USA: WLR ups chicken output at N.C. complex.
newsitem.headline: WLR ups chicken output at N.C. complex.

text.p: WLR Foods Inc said Thursday it plans to increase its total chicken output by about 10 percent through the expansion of its Goldsboro, N.C. chicken complex.
The company also said it is reducing turkey production in its Marshville, N.C., complex where the disease Poult Enteritis Mortality Syndrome (PEMS) has dramatically affected flock performance.

WLR said it aims to double the capacity of the Goldsboro chicken complex to 650,000 birds a week. The expansion will add more than 100 poultry houses and increase employment at the complex from 400 people to nearly 700 people.

Regarding the turkeys, the company said it developed a plan to contain the impact and spread of the disease by reducing turkey density in the Union County area and increasing its biosecurity and management practices.
